lines.text: The LORD says the people were sold for their iniquities, and asks why no one answered when He called.
The LORD says His rebuke dries up the sea, and He clothes the heavens in black.
The Lord GOD awakens the speaker's ear morning by morning, and the speaker has not been rebellious.
The speaker offers his back to those who struck him and does not hide his face, setting it like water.
Opponents wear out like a garment, and those who kindle fires lie down in a place of rest.
